page_title: MNU 2-1 CHE | Manchester Utd v Chelsea 06/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' There's an opportunity for Reece James (Chelsea) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+5' Reece James (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.
90+4' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+2' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Alejandro Garnacho will be replaced by Jonny Evans (Manchester United).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Armando Broja (Chelsea) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
85' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
84' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is replaced by Marcus Rashford.
82' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.

80' Sergio Reguilon slides a brilliant pass into Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
77' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to substitute Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) and he is replaced by Armando Broja.
75' Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.

74' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his low drive towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
74' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
73' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
71' No foul! Referee Chris Kavanagh points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Manchester Utd players.
70' The Manchester Utd players halt their celebrations as referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

69' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) makes it 2:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Alejandro Garnacho and planted his close-range header into the top of the net. Robert Sanchez was helpless.

69' Antony (Manchester United) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
68' The resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) comes to nothing.
64' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
64' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.
62' Surely that's handball by one of the Chelsea players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
61' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
61' Antony (Manchester United) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Manchester Utd get a corner.

60' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a throw-in.
59' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
57' Flag up against Reece James (Chelsea). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

55' A brilliant individual effort! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
55' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
54' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd in a dangerous position.
52' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) works the corner short.

52' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.
52' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.

49' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
49' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
48' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sergio Reguilon comes on the pitch for Victor Lindelof (Manchester United).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Mauricio Pochettino gives a chance to Reece James and Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' Chris Kavanagh has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a cross from the corner, but Robert Sanchez reads it well and gathers the ball.
45+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.

45+5' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+3' Dangerous play by Luke Shaw (Manchester United). Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Chelsea have a free kick.
45+2' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Chelsea get a free kick.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.

45' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Mykhailo Mudryk slips the ball through to Cole Palmer (Chelsea), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.

43' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
43' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) prepares to take a corner kick.
42' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United). Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
41' Chris Kavanagh couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) and blew his whistle. Manchester Utd win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
40' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
38' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) picks up an injury.
37' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

36' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
34' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!

32' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Robert Sanchez, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.

32' What a save from Robert Sanchez! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
31' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
30' The current number of shots on goal is 5:1. 12:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
29' The linesman signals that Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
28' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Rasmus Hojlund. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
26' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Chelsea as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
26' There's a break in play and referee Chris Kavanagh must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Chelsea using VAR. This could be interesting!
25' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
24' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
22' The game is interrupted. Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
21' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
19' 1 - 0 Scott McTominay (Manchester United) collects a rebound and hits it precisely into the bottom right corner.
19' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
19' It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.

18' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Manchester Utd have a corner.

18' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) after he collected a pass and unleashed a daisy-cutter. The ball was directed into the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
15' Antony (Manchester United) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez easily deals with the threat.
15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luke Shaw (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

13' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) gets inside the box and tries to beat Robert Sanchez with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

12' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

11' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Kavanagh no option but to blow his whistle. Manchester Utd will take a free kick.
10' Antony (Manchester United) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.

9' Close! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.

9' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Robert Sanchez anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
9' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
8' The Manchester Utd players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

7' Play continues despite the shouts by some Manchester Utd players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

6' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester Utd are going to take it.
6' PENALTY APPEAL by Manchester Utd, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
6' Good clearance! Antony (Manchester United) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

3' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Robert Sanchez anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.

3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
2' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd have a free kick.
1' The ball is cleared after Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will referee today's match.
